resources.string: Crop coordinates refer to the displayed, orientation-adjusted decoded image, not full-resolution original pixels. Left/top start at zero; right/bottom are excluded.
With aspect ratio locked, output width determines height from the crop, rounded to nearest pixel. With it unlocked, width and height are independent and can stretch the image.
Use a nonempty crop within the decoded image, output dimensions from 1–2,048 with at most 4,000,000 pixels, and quality from 1–100. Nothing is clamped or truncated.

Select one image using Android’s picker. GearBox does not request broad photo access, persist URI access or upload it. Decode limits: 20 MiB encoded, 40 million original pixels and 12,000 pixels per side. The working image is reduced to at most 2,048 pixels per side and 4 million pixels, converted to sRGB and orientation-adjusted. Animated inputs use their first frame.

Generate re-encodes the cropped/resized pixels. PNG keeps transparency; JPEG composites it on white; WebP uses lossy encoding. Quality is ignored for PNG and does not guarantee a particular file size. Source metadata is not copied, but visible content can still identify people or places. This is not anonymization.

Source and generated preview are discarded when leaving or recreating this screen. Only format, quality and aspect-lock preferences may be remembered if enabled in Settings. Images are never History, presets or Workbench items. Temporary encoded copies can remain in app cache after leaving so receiving apps can read shared files; they are not permanently saved unless you explicitly save a copy.

Choose a destination for a new file. GearBox does not overwrite the selected original. Rotation, leaving this screen or changing the image cancels a pending export; select a destination again afterward. Cancelling after writing begins may leave an incomplete new file; the original is unchanged.
The app you choose will receive this encoded image, including any private information visible in its pixels. Cancel if you do not want to share it.
Could not complete this image operation. Try another supported image or smaller output. No successful export is confirmed.
The image changed or this screen was recreated. The pending export was cancelled. If a destination file was created, it may be empty or incomplete.
Choose an image to set crop, dimensions and format. Picking an image does not generate or export anything.
